title: Fiber-Shield Industries, Inc. v Fiber Shield Ltd.
text:
THE NATIONAL ARBITRATION FORUM

PO BOX 50191

MINNEAPOLIS, MINNESOTA 5405 USA

Fiber-Shield Industries, Inc.,

26 Old Dock Road

Yaphank, NY 11980,

COMPLAINANT

vs.

Fiber Shield LTD.

3-130 Don Park Rd.

Markham, ON L2R-1C3

CA,

RESPONDENT

DECISION

FILE NO.: FA0001000092054

The above entitled matter came on for an administrative
hearing on February 29, 2000 before the undersigned arbitrator on the
Complaint of Fiber-Shield Industries, Inc. ("Complainant"),
represented by Patrick O. Killian, Esq., Killian, Legakis, & Vetere
L.L.P., 1067 A Route 25A, Stoney Brook, New York 11790, against Fiber
Shield LTD. ("Respondent"), represented by Irene L. Matthews,
Esq., Suite 104 Chelsea Square, 7225 Woodvine Ave., Markham, Ontario L3R-1C3.
Upon the written submitted record including the Complaint, the Response
to Complaint and Complainant’s Rebuttal to Respondent’s Reply
to Complaint, the following DECISION is rendered:

PROCEDURAL FINDINGS

Domain Name: fibershield.net

Domain Name Registrar: Network Solutions

Date of Domain Name Registration: June 28, 1997

Date Complaint Filed: January 18, 2000

Date Response to Complaint Filed: February 10, 2000

After reviewing the complaint, and determining it
to be in administrative compliance, the National Arbitration Forum ("Forum")
forwarded the Complaint to the Respondent on January 20, 2000 in compliance
with Rule 2(a) and the administrative proceeding was commenced pursuant
to Rule 4(c). In compliance with Rule 4(d), the Forum immediately notified
Network Solutions that the administrative proceeding had commenced. The
Complaint, the Response and Complainant’s Rebuttal to Respondent’s
Reply to Complaint were docketed and forwarded to the undersigned Arbitrator
for decision.

FINDINGS OF FACT

1. Neither the complainant nor the respondent
contest the jurisdiction of the Forum or the undersigned arbitrator to
resolve this controversy.

2. Complainant has a United States Patent and
Trademark Office registration number 1, 429,690 dated October 13, 1999
for the mark "FIBER-SHIELD"

3. Complainant registered the domain fibershield.com
on or about June 13, 1997 with Network Solutions, Inc.

4. Respondent has been incorporated and has been
doing business in Canada under the name "Fiber Shield (Toronto) LTD.".
There is no allegation of respondent that there has been a trademark registration
anywhere for any variation of its corporate name, although there is an
allegation of respondent that it owns the "Fiber-Seal" trademark.

5. Respondent claims that it was unaware of the
business activity of complainant under the name "Fiber Shield Industries,
Inc.", or any variation thereof, until it attempted to register its
own domain name as "fiber-shield.com". Upon being advised of
the unavailability of such name due to complainant’s prior registration,
respondent proceeded to register the domain "fibershield.net."

6. It appears clear that respondent registered
fibershield.net with actual awareness of a confusingly similar prior registration
in favor of complainant. It further appears clear that respondent does
not claim any rights superior to the trademark registration of complainant
of the name "fiber-shield", in Canada, the United States or
elsewhere.

7. In light of the above, I find that respondent
registered the domain name fibershield.net in bad faith and that respondent
has no rights or legitimate interest with respect to said domain name.

CONCLUSION

The undersigned certifies that he has acted independently
and has no known conflict of interest to serve as the Arbitrator in this
proceeding. Having been duly selected, and being impartial, the undersigned
makes the following findings and conclusions:

1. The domain name "fibershield.net"
should be and hereby is canceled.

2. Respondent does not have rights or legitimate
interests in respect of the domain name "fibershield.net" because
it is not making a legitimate noncommercial or fair use of the domain
name, without the intent for commercial gain, to misleadingly divert customers
or to tarnish the trademark or service mark at issue.

DECISION

Based upon the above findings and conclusions, and
pursuant to Rule 4(i) of the ICANN’s Rules for Uniform Domain Name
Dispute Resolution Policy and the National Arbitration Forum’s Supplemental
Rules to ICANN’s Uniform Domain Resolution Policy, it is decided
as follows:

THE UNDERSIGNED DIRECTS THAT THE DOMAIN NAME " fibershield.net "
REGISTERED BY RESPONDENT FIBER-SHIELD (TORONTO) LTD. BE CANCELED.

Signed this 29th day of February, 2000 by Judge James
A. Carmody (Retired), Arbitrator.
